name: tower
description: A status page that runs on Cloudflare Workers: a cron prober, D1 history and email alerts.

scripts.dev: node tools/stage.ts test/fixture && (npm run dev -w prober & npm run dev -w page; wait)
scripts.check: node tools/stage.ts test/fixture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build -w page && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w prober && npm run typecheck -w page && tsc -p tools
